faqs.q: Sec. 18-415. - I.P.C. Section 703.3, Sanitary and storm sewers.
faqs.a:
Section 703.3. Sanitary and storm sewers,
is hereby amended in its entirety to read as follows:
"
703.3. Sanitary and storm sewers.
Where separate systems of sanitary drainage and storm drainage are installed in the
                  same property, the sanitary and storm building sewers shall be installed as set forth
                  in the Arvada Engineering Standards."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 11, 9-14-2020)
